text:
Henrik Dalloway has been confirmed as chair of the Marrowgate Water Board after a vote at the board's annual general meeting on 14 March 2024.

Seven of the nine board members voted in favour of his appointment. Priya Vennhalt, the Board Secretary, read out the confirmed appointment and recorded the vote.

The result is set out in the meeting minutes (Ref. MWB-AGM-2024-03), which have been published on the board's public records page.

Ms Vennhalt said the process followed the board's usual procedure. "The appointment was put to the full board, the vote was counted and the outcome is recorded in the minutes for anyone to read," she said.

Mr Dalloway now leads the board, which oversees water services for Marrowgate. The published minutes remain available to residents on the board's website.
